profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Consultant at Memory Networks
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in C#, ASP.NET MVC, ORM (EntityFramework and NHibernate), Scala/Kotlin/Java, Spark, Algorithms, and Agile development. Strong engineering professional with a Computer Science MS focused in Machine Learning from University of Wisconsin-Madison.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Consultant
positions.description:
- Built numerical simulator and machine learning tools in Scala with Kotlin bindings
- Integrated simulator with Complex Event Processing module using Drools Fusion
- Wrote visualization library for Keras/Python trained neural networks 
- Consulting for ASP.NET MVC web application, Entity Framework DAL, and WCF service layer in C#

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
- Built, tested, and maintained ASP.NET MVC web application in C# with NHibernate, LINQ
- Built, tested, and maintained WCF web services in C# with client Java Android app
- Mentored and helped manage 10+ team practicing Agile/Scrum development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented Drools expert system working with subject matter experts
- Extended EEG Eclipse application and optimized JPA/Hibernate remote connections
- Design and implement data warehouse using ETL process
- Implement and apply machine learning techniques to analyze large EEG datasets

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Research Assistant for dynamic systems theory MATLAB simulators used in robotics
- Teaching Assistant for Introduction to Computer Science
- Attended Wisconsin Entrepreneurial Bootcamp for grads in engineering or business

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Consultant
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented n-tier model using ASP.NET, AJAX Controls, C#, NHibernate, Castle Windsor IoC, NUnit, and SQL Server in Visual Studio Team System
- Built advanced data report engine with user customizable saved reports 
- Built CMS with tagging, permission levels, full-text search, publishing features, and companion Windows service that allowed user customizable e-mail alerts 
- Worked with many stakeholders to redesign legacy financial data schemas 
- Mentored developers, aided staffing decisions, and practiced Scrum development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Consultant
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented n-tier model using ASP.NET, C#, NHibernate, AJAX, and MySQL
- Worked directly with stakeholders to develop use cases and user requirements
- Practiced Test-Driven Development, Continuous Integration, and Agile Development

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Lead developer on social network analysis Java application for DoD  
  * Applied Bayesian networks, ILOG JRules, and graph theory algorithms
  * Worked directly with different subject matter experts on user requirements
  * Managed and mentored small team of developers 
- Lead developer on several other Java applications 
  * MM5 weather data analysis and visualization for AFRL
  * GIS data uncertainty visualization for NASA
  * Sensor network data analysis and visualization for ARL
- Gained experience with ESRI GIS, ILOG JRules, ORM, XML, Ant, JUnit, Eclipse, Lucane, IoC, JDBC, RMDBS, and design patterns

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented C++ wrapper for ATL-COM based digital video broadcast decoder
- Implemented Java wrapper for GUI test application
- Worked closely with multiple developers to integrate components

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Restructured/redesigned DVD video data structures library
- Implemented high level API and additional component
- Took courses on Java and OOP with Design Patterns
